description_en: Retrieves a list of message templates
kebab_example: aliyun cams list-chatapp-template --name hello_whatsapp --biz-language en --audit-status pass --page page_:_index_:_1,_size_:_20 --cust-waba-id 659216218160000 --cust-space-id 282514865123580000 --template-type WHATSAPP --code 83888882200000 --category AUTHENTICATION --isv-code skdi3kksloslikdkkdk --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListChatappTemplate

parameters.help_en: The language of the template. For more information about language codes, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/463420.html
parameters.help_zh: 模板语言。 详细语言代码，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/463420.html
parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en:
The review status. Valid values:

pass: Approved.

fail: Rejected.

auditing: Under review.

unaudit: Review suspended
parameters.help_zh:
审核状态。取值：

pass：通过审核。

fail：拒绝审核。

auditing：审核中。

unaudit：审核暂停处理
parameters.name: audit_status

fields.help_en: The number of templates to query per page. Default value: 10
fields.help_zh: 每次查询模板数量，默认为10
fields.name: size

parameters.help_en:
The WabaId of the ISV customer.

This is a deprecated parameter. Use CustSpaceId instead
parameters.help_zh:
ISV客户WabaId

过时的参数，请使用CustSpaceId
parameters.name: cust_waba_id

parameters.help_en: The space ID of the ISV sub-customer, or the instance ID of a direct customer
parameters.help_zh: ISV子客户的SpaceId/直客客户实例ID
parameters.name: cust_space_id

parameters.help_en:
The templatetype. Valid values:

WHATSAPP

VIBER
parameters.name: template_type

parameters.help_en: The ISV verification code, which is used to verify whether the RAM user is authorized by the ISV
parameters.help_zh: ISV校验码，用于校验子账号是否由ISV授权
parameters.name: isv_code
